brief: A PR review and remediation platform for developers. Minimal, geometric, and works perfectly in light/dark mode.

concepts.name: The Cube Eye
concepts.idea: An isometric cube holding an eye, combining geometric code structure with AI review.
rationale: Highly geometric and crisp at 16px size.
Draws strictly in one color, adapting effortlessly to IDE themes.
Central 'eye' signifies the AI review process.

next_steps: Implement the favicon and web app manifest

Update social media assets using the provided PNGs
